verdict: Do not sign off this exact build for release on this evidence
scope: Emulator-only exploratory Android QA. The full requested end-to-end campaign/payment coverage is incomplete.
countMeaning: Counts are scoped test records, not every assertion in the brief. Passed mission attempts mean a legitimate loss/result was observed; no mission clear passed.

tests.title: Verify the exact installed build
tests.preconditions: Fresh QA emulator profile; disconnected; no pass; 0 credits; 0 campaign clears.

tests.actual: Both file and installed APK match ab3634620ba0a81302ee3bf378f1707abd6f61cc56f105df32ecd30aacf014ff. Installed version is 0.3.24/code 27. issues.title: Android input ANR during checkout-to-leaderboard navigation
issues.fact: An Android ANR dialog appeared, and ActivityManager recorded a 5,112 ms MotionEvent timeout. Repeated Wait did not provide lasting recovery. Video 06 shows the ANR dialog at 00:50.
issues.hypothesis: Main/UI thread scheduling or rendering pressure; recording codec and emulator CPU contention are confounders. No root cause proved.
issues.fix: Profile main-thread blocking and rendering during modal dismissal, wallet errors and destination changes. Keep navigation responsive and recover without requiring process restart.
issues.verify: Repeat the exact missing-wallet → rapid Connect → Back → Leaderboard sequence 20 times on physical Android and the emulator, both recorded and unrecorded. Capture main-thread traces; require no ANR and timely input response.

issues.title: Outfit cards leave an empty third column on the primary test size
issues.fact: Both grids display two narrow columns with a large empty right strip at 1080×2400/420 dpi. Small profile fits three columns.
issues.hypothesis: Width formula uses window width while the actual scroll content is narrower, possibly with fractional rounding.
issues.fix: Compute card width from measured container width and gaps so the intended column count fits. This reduces unnecessary scrolling and balances the shop.
issues.verify: At both tested densities and an intermediate width, show all columns without overflow, large unused strips or clipped fixed actions.

issues.title: Pass and skin checkout hide the actionable missing-wallet reason
issues.fact: No compatible wallet is installed. Pass/skin show a generic wallet request failure, while Add Credits names the missing-wallet condition.
issues.hypothesis: Different error presentation paths or retained wallet error state.
issues.fix: Use the specific missing-wallet message consistently and provide a clear install/open-wallet route plus Retry. The player should know what to do without sharing diagnostics.
issues.verify: On a clean device without wallet, open each purchase entry and confirm the same actionable message; install a test wallet and retry successfully.

issues.title: History asks for wallet connection without a connect action
issues.fact: Disconnected History says “Connect your wallet to see your runs” but has no local Connect button.
issues.hypothesis: Empty state is informational text only.
issues.fix: Add Connect wallet in the empty state and return users to History after cancellation or connection.
issues.verify: From a disconnected launch, reach History and connect/cancel without leaving for the store; after connection fetch the actual account history.
reproduction: Read “Connect your wallet to see your runs”
Look for a connect action in this view

issues.title: First phone preview is blank before the model appears
issues.fact: Initial Frost capture after about two seconds shows an empty stage with rotation instructions. A later back view renders. Exact ready time is not known.
issues.hypothesis: Filament/model initialization is asynchronous without visible progress.
issues.fix: Show a loading state until the model is ready, then reveal rotation controls; provide retry/error feedback on failure.
issues.verify: Cold-open all phone previews on physical hardware and a throttled emulator; require immediate loading feedback and a visible model or actionable error.
reproduction: First open of Frost phone preview

issues.title: Software-renderer black-frame artifact
issues.fact: Tutorial produced a black lower frame with swiftshader_indirect; the later host-GPU run did not show it.
issues.hypothesis: Software-renderer compatibility or capture path rather than confirmed app-wide rendering defect.
issues.fix: Document the supported emulator graphics configuration and investigate only if it reproduces on supported physical GPUs.
issues.verify: Repeat tutorial on a physical Android device and host-GPU emulator with identical APK; inspect both display and recording.
reproduction: Restart QA emulator with host GPU
